FX-HUESAT-001.says: All three at 0, the defaults: the drawing, untouched.

FX-HUESAT-002.says: Hue +120: red turns green, green blue, and blue red; magenta, at 300, goes past 360 to 60, yellow; the grey and the empty pixels stay as they are, and the soft edge keeps its half covering.

FX-HUESAT-003.says: Hue -120: red turns blue, green red, and blue green.

FX-HUESAT-004.says: Hue -30: red, at 0, goes below 0 to 330, a pink-red #ff0080.

FX-HUESAT-005.says: Hue +90: magenta, at 300, goes past 360 to 30, orange #ff8000.

FX-HUESAT-006.says: Hue 180: every colour turns to its opposite, red to cyan; the grey stays.

FX-HUESAT-007.says: Saturation -100: every pixel turns grey at its own lightness, red, green, blue and magenta all to mid grey; the grey stays.

FX-HUESAT-008.says: Saturation +100: the line's saturation doubles, and the skin's, at 0.76, is held at 1, fully vivid, at the same hue and lightness; the pure primaries and magenta, already full, and the grey stay.

FX-HUESAT-009.says: Saturation -50: every colour half way to grey.

FX-HUESAT-010.says: Lightness +100: every shown pixel turns white at its own covering, the soft edge white at half; the empty pixels stay empty.

FX-HUESAT-011.says: Lightness -100: every shown pixel turns black at its own covering.

FX-HUESAT-012.says: Lightness +50: red's lightness goes from 0.5 half way to 1, to #ff8080.

FX-HUESAT-013.says: Lightness -50: red's lightness goes from 0.5 half way to 0, to #800000.

FX-HUESAT-014.says: Hue 60, saturation -50, lightness 20 together: red turns a pale, soft yellow; the grey is lightened only.

FX-HUESAT-015.says: Hue keyed from -180 at frame 0 to 180 at frame 4, linear: frames 0 and 4 are both FX-HUESAT-006, half a turn either way; frame 2, at 0, is the drawing untouched.

FX-HUESAT-016.says: Saturation keyed from -100 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: frame 0 is FX-HUESAT-007, frame 2 the drawing, frame 4 FX-HUESAT-008.

FX-HUESAT-017.says: FX-HUESAT-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-HUESAT-018.says: Hue 181, above 180. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HUESAT-019.says: Hue -181, below -180. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HUESAT-020.says: Saturation 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HUESAT-021.says: Lightness -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HUESAT-022.says: Hue keyed to 200 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HUESAT-023.says: Lightness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
